title: A good help
body: For those of us that don’t use our phones for everything, the laptop or PC version is very, very helpful. I am grateful to be able to use the app this way. And I appreciate that it is easy to use and one doesn’t have to be too techy to use it.

title: Tracking app
body: I was looking for a way to workout and track it.This was one of the best ones that I could find so far I have really liked it and hope to stay consistent each day.

title: Keeps Me Motivated!
body: Coach Mario is awesome! Between his regular check ins and tips, and the way use of the app, Caliber keeps me accountable.

title: Functionality good, extremely limited exercises
body: I made it through the free trial, but will not pay for this app. There are extremely limited exercise exercises for each body part. I ended up having to supplement each workout with a ton of exercises on my own. Definitely not worth paying for.

title: Number 1 App
body: Best workout companion! Best app out there! And it’s Free! Upgrade for more benefits!   I been using the app for the past Two years and don’t need anything else!  Nice job Caliber!

title: One month after downloading
body: So far I am very happy with how the app has helped me format my workouts, the video demonstrations and descriptions are very helpful and have shown me how to do exercises I’ve never done. I feel the results of my new exercises and this seems to be just as good as paid apps.

title: Free review
body: I enjoy the app it’s great for first time gym users and is super friendly. Lots of options for free users. I can even see the value for the subscription. Not ready to commit to that just yet though personally.

title: Very user-unfriendly
body: Very bad selection of exercises. Lots of standard machines not even on there.

title: Great gym coach
body: I have followed these exercises with an online coach during four months and getting great results. I found it so good that my wife also joined. I will recommend highly. The best coach on the gym, only if you are serious to develop your muscles and improve your strength. The coach even check how was my diet and recommended some food supplements that have helped.

title: Has helped a newbie out!
body: Great app for beginners. It helped map out my workouts and allows me to adjust them.

title: So far I love it
body: Just started using this app and I love it. I do wish they would include stretches for the workouts so no injuries happen. It would be extremely knowledgeable for beginners and advanced workouts.

title: It’s more than a workout planner
body: I’d highly recommend Caliber to anyone. I’d say I’m recommending the whole plan more than the app. It helps you understand how to body works, has in depth videos on how to do the workouts, but most of all, it has trainers. And the trainers make all the difference. Meeting with them, learning with them and helping them keep you accountable is really what makes this program stand out.

title: Excellent
body: I really like the Caliber app. It’s super easy to use and tracks your workouts and nutrition. I like having weekly calls with your coach and the additional support. I highly recommend Caliber.

title: Highly recommend!!
body: I have the premium/coaching version of the app & I’ve really enjoyed my time working with my coach Kirsten! She’s taught me so much & answers all of my questions thoroughly & thoughtfully. She is very knowledgeable on both exercise & nutrition which are both important to my goals. The video chats are very helpful as well. They have great flexible renewal options after the initial 3 month coaching period which I will likely use in the future once I make some more progress on my own. The tracking functions on the app are super helpful as well which I will continue using after my coaching subscription ends.

title: Definitely not free
body: Per the add it’s free when I download it was actually only a free trial. The price is not that bad so I signed up for the free trial just to check it out and see if it’s worth it. When I clicked free trial it immediately charged me $19.99

title: Caliber: Strength Training
body: This app is free! I put in my workout regime, it remembers and tracks everything I input.

title: Ideal for Anyone
body:
I’ve been working out for the better part of 17 years and since having children struggled to get my weight back under control, manage a consistent workout routine, and set up macro targets that would support my goals.

Caliber did all of this with ease. They helped me lose weight, gain confidence, and establish my routine. 

Admittedly this is not a cheap service. I was forced to cut them because of financial constraints. But my time with them was highly valuable and I have no regrets for it.

If times were different I’d wish to complete the program and my goals with their support but the rest of my journey is in my hands alone. I still use the free services in the app to keep track of my progress. 

Give them a shot. You won’t be disappointed.

title: It’s okay
body: Free version is okay but you really can’t do too much at all with it without the premium version. Probably be better off just googling some plans if you don’t want to pay. Not bad though

title: Great App
body: The app is designed for beginners all the way up to advanced. The overviews are extremely helpful and the information the app provides is excellent and easy to follow.

title: Great Experience
body: I chose the middle tier, and I was thrilled with my experience. I worked with Grant Slama. He was very encouraging. He communicated well and laid out the plan clearly. The app is easy to use and makes it nearly impossible not to achieve your goals. I hope to renew in the future.

title: Scam likely
body: It’s not free like they said it was In The ad

title: Not for me
body: I’ve been working out for about 10 years now and never tried an app so this was my first experience and I really didn’t like it. It’s so overly complicated. I am only in my 30s so I know how to use a phone but I was basically spending half my workout messing with the app, it was really wasting my gym time. Have you ever heard of cognitive overload? So overwhelming all the different screens, buttons, small fonts at time. Didn’t work for me at all and their contact us button didn’t work either so I couldn’t even get help. Canceling my free trial now. The app itself is built really well, great job developers. UI/UX could use some work

title: Real coaching, not just an app
body: I spent a year training on my own before joining Caliber, and having a real coach has been night and day. My coach, Sawleh, built my program from my actual training history — not just a quick intake call — and recorded a personal video walking me through the plan and the reasoning behind it. He's genuinely responsive in the app, we do monthly strategy calls, and the programming adapts as I go. He even gave me the confidence to finally pick up free weights after a year of machines. If you've plateaued training solo, Caliber is absolutely worth it.

title: Best Workout App I have used to date!
body: This is a you get what you pay for situation. It is more expensive than some maybe used to. It just depends on what your goals are. If you want to work closely with a professional trainer that can help you tailor your diet and workout plans to ensure maxim results in minimum time, this is a great way to do that. If your primary concern is something cheap, this may not be the best option for you. If top notch customer service, quality trainers, and workout plans that will get you in phenomenal shape, make the investment in yourself. I promise you won’t be sorry.

title: Best Fitness App
body: Best, affordable, user-friendly app that I have come across. I love the workout tracker, workout library, and all of the other features!

title: Great value
body: Reasonably priced app to track progress

title: Can you overcomplicate an app more than this? I say no!
body:
It’s a classic case of engineering logic overriding human behavior. 

Obviously there are many people that love this app, I am clearly not their target and I don’t have the time or patience to invest that this app requires just to create a simple workout and track it.

title: Best FREE fitness app
body: This one about the only fitness app I could find that had all the features I wanted for the price off FREE! Easy to follow a trainer’s program tailored to your liking, and you can add/delete certain workouts as needed.

title: This has been a really great journey!
body: I have used Caliber in every tier available , from the free version to the live coaching premium, and I cannot recommend it enough! Overall design and features  are conducive to beginners as well as persons who have advanced in their fitness knowledge and want greater flexibility and customization in building workouts. I have worked with trainer Jonathan Swenson for a year and a half now. With him I have not only have I accomplished significant body recomposition and strength gains, but I have a knowledge foundation that will serve me for the rest of my fitness journey. This is all a result of Jonathan‘s positive and supportive approach, quick response time, and honest and productive feedback. I highly recommend working with Jonathan Swenson if you go to the premium coaching route! Thanks Caliber and thanks, Jonathan!

title: Great App
body: I have been using caliber and it has made my workouts more enjoyable and efficient.

title: Great coach but meh app
body: My coach is excellent. I really enjoy that part of the experience. The app, not so much. It’s got lots of oddities that make it feel unpolished. I did take the time to share extensive feedback with them but the company seems focused on big shiny objects instead of quality-of-life stuff that makes day to day use, data entry easier. Before you commit to $4500/year for coaching do your self a favor and play with the app during real workouts, so you can experience the many paper cuts.

title: APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
body: Really enjoy this app. It’s super user friendly and I love that most of the features are available without paying for a premium plan. BUT PLEASE MAKE IT SO THE APP CAN LINK WITH APPLE WATCHES. EVEN IF ITS JUST DISPLAYING THE REST TIMER PLEASE 🙏🏽

title: App Review
body: Great App. It has really made a difference in my fitness.

title: 100% recommend for newbies
body: I feel like this app keeps me consistent, and also gives me a way to progressively overload and make sure that I am improving each week. It being free is just the cherry on top.

title: Made the switch from EverFit
body: I am very pleased with this app. I wanted something with tutorial videos, timers, reps and set counters, and weight trackers, and this has all of that.

title: Gratitude
body:
I started using Caliber over two years ago while recovering from rotator cuff surgery. At first, what I needed most was structure and accountability, and Caliber gave me both. Having a place to track my workouts helped me stay consistent, and I started seeing real gains.

Eventually, though, I hit a plateau. I was putting in the work, but I wasn't sure I was spending my time in the gym as effectively as I could. That's when I started working with Regi.

Regi brings a great combination of knowledge, enthusiasm, and genuine care for his clients. He completely reworked my programs, and I started seeing progress almost immediately. More importantly, he takes a real interest in helping his clients succeed. Our weekly meetings are something I genuinely look forward to.

Working with Regi and Caliber has put me in the best shape of my life at 54. I've gotten stronger, more confident, and more disciplined, and I've enjoyed the process along the way. You still have to put in the work, but with Regi in your corner, you will become a better version of yourself.

title: A Blessing
body: I love they have a free section and a section you can pay for.

title: It’s free
body: It said it’s free and it’s free. Some special features are unavailable but workout plans, logging, profile, connectivity to other apps seems to be good to go. Might pay later but I want to get more familiar first.

title: Best Workout App IMO
body: I’ve tried over 20 fitness apps in the past 5 years and nothing comes close to Caliber. Fully customizable, quick bug fixes when reported, no ads (except for their personal coaching option), and they offer personal training via online staff (haven’t used but can see how this is useful for those just getting their fitness journey started). Also love their starter programs where you can choose your equipment and it gives you a simple program to complete with video clips displaying how to do the movement. I recommend this app to everybody, thank you Caliber team!

title: Best workout app, it’s that simple
body: Title says it all. stop wasting time on other apps.

title: Caliber plus
body: Great app, it really helps keep me motivated to go to the gym. My only suggestion is that they allow the free version to make custom workouts. I currently can’t track my Plyometrics on the app, and would love to be able to do that. Maybe you could add plyometric workouts to the app?

title: Good for free
body: The best things about the app is the tracker and workout planner.  Better than notepad and pen.  Have not tried the coaching stuff yet.  Been using it for the past 2 years

title: Family’s new Fav App
body: My husband and I have been married for a year now and have decided to get back in shape and better health TOGETHER! Thank you!

title: Excellent Service
body: Exactly what I hoped it would be. I’m 3 months in and have been more consistent with exercise and nutrition than I’ve ever been. Great for busy professionals.

title: Great Coaching!
body: In 2025, I broke my back—an L3 compression fracture. Once I was feeling ready to work out again with weights I knew I needed a strength coach. The Caliber app and Coach Tess were a perfect next step for me as a busy mom of two and working full time. As a self described athlete I have danced, hiked, lifted, done yoga and had years of running. Tess was a supportive coach, she listened and designed a safe plan for me. I have been training for 3 months consistently. My check ins are fruitful and between sessions we text through the app. There is power well thought out plans, Tess really got me. I am excited to continue using the app. Tess was also able to see my food tracking through the app (sync with Chronometer) and we discussed nutrition and macro goals. This week I am stronger and looking forward to my workouts. My pain has improved, I am building my bone health through weight training and I have had no setbacks due to Tess’ coaching.

title: Drummer Singer
body: I love that you can actually see what the workout targets and what those muscles do. I also absolutely love the workouts.

title: Fantastic
body: Great app, easy to use, great for learning about workouts.

title: A Must Use App For Gym Goers
body:
Caliber has helped me with my strength training in ways I didn’t know I needed help in.  I went with the premium coaching plan and as I am near the end of my three months (spoiler: I will be renewing) my body has improved in such a short amount of time.

I love being able to track the weight, how many reps I did before in the past, what muscle groups the exercise hits.  I have to shout out my coach Kaitlyn who has helped me improve and is always quick to answer any questions I have about the exercise and how to modify it if needed.

It is a bit pricey but the results I’ve seen and feel are worth it.  I feel like I can eat and exercise without any guilt or guesswork of what to be doing anymore.  Would recommend to anyone who needs structure to their workouts and doesn’t know what to do or where to start.

title: Functional
body: App is easy to use and offers great guidance for different exercises.

title: Nice app- some wrong tutorial videos
body: This app is very nice and very helpful in planning an exercise routine. One workout I’ve noticed already- bird dog, the instructions say not to raise your leg too high and to keep it parallel to the floor. But then the video shows this guy lifting his foot above his head! Thank god as a beginner I 1. Checked the instructions instead of copying the video and 2. I checked on google how to properly do it. I’m wondering how many exercises on here on being shown incorrectly.

title: Well worth it
body: Great app that has helped me tremendously in achieving my fitness goals, and the customer service is excellent. They genuinely care.

title: Coach Jordan
body: Have had a wonderful experience working with Coach Jordan over the last three months. He clearly knows a considerable amount about strength training and he approaches his role and shares his expertise without a hint of arrogance. I made clear my goals to him at the outset of our time together and he built a program that seamlessly aligns. Beyond the actual programming, he has helped tailor my diet to increased protein and carbs intake that reinforce my goals. He checks in almost daily on how I’m doing (even on weekends), some of which delves into training but a lot of which is a more personal, friendly check-in to see how I’m feel and how the day has gone. Suffice it to say that I’ve re-upped for another six months because I’ve so thoroughly enjoyed Coach Jordan’s guidance, friendship, and teaching.

title: unintuitive
body: let me lookup workouts without having to be interrogated. ridiculous that i have to answer 15+ questions, make an account, and still not be able to intuitively find exercises that workout the muscle groups i want

title: Game Changer for me!!!
body:
This app has made a huge difference for me! In years gone by, I’d start working out without knowing what I was doing, see no results because I had no plan AND didn’t know what I was doing. 
I started with the free version and liked the ability to research, plan, watch videos, and proceed. Then I began to consider the coaching option. I was assigned Michael P as my coach and he has made all the difference for me. We discussed my history, health, and goals. He has assigned great weekly workouts and I have seen fabulous changes…physically and mentally. I am sticking with my health journey more consistently than ever before. Thank you Caliber and thank you Coach Michael!!!

title: Highly Recommend!
body: I am so happy that I listened to Chris when we discussed the plans being offered.  I was new to weight training.  I wanted to get started but didn’t know how and didn’t want to risk injury.  I signed up for the highest level to have the regular zoom meetings with my coach in the beginning then stepped down afterwards to the lower level which is only messaging.  My coach Taryn is amazing.  I explained how often and how much time I could commit.  She sets up everything from my calorie count with macros and workouts 3x week.  She gives advice and words of encouragement.  Even listens and gives recommendations when I am down.  I have lost 33# and highly recommend to spend the extra time and money to step forward as she is the reason my body  and overall health has improved.  You are worth it!

title: Great app to get fit
body: This is an app that is great for beginners and intermediate. I use this app for a live exercises to go from a chubby 259 to a fit 230!  It is definitely worth the download.

title: Amazingly helpful and easy!!
body: This app is so easy to use and extremely helpful. I previously created my own workout routine which took hours. I stumbled upon this app and my home workout has stepped up exponentially. It’s easy to track my progress and adjust the workout plans. Exercises can be removed and/or added to the plans. It has options to enter the type of equipment available whether exercising at home and/or a gym. And a huge bonus, it is free! It also has the option to upgrade to a personal coach who not only provides training input but also nutrition. I have not done this but it is available.   I HIGHLY recommend this to anyone who is interested in amping up their workout routine.

title: Great app!
body: Functional, well equipped exercise selections and training tools.

title: Legit
body: This app has helped me hit milestones and motivates me like nothing else ever has!

title: Meh
body: Workout tracking is good, chronometer sync is awesome… the fact that they consistently drop your strength score week to week to upsell coaching is annoying af. At what it costs they could at least be honest and not try to shove coaching down your throat. Strong is what I switched to same type of tracking, $99 for lifetime access, no upsells… yeah. Caliber could be very good if it did what it does without trying to make it look like you’re constantly back tracking just to push their $200+ coaching.

title: Highly recommend
body:
I highly recommend Caliber. The value is incredible. The results I’ve seen, combined with the level of support and guidance I receive, far exceed what I pay. I especially appreciate that the program includes nutrition guidance alongside workouts, which takes the guesswork out of building muscle and losing fat. The app is super easy to use. I’m addicted to seeing the amount of weight I can lift increase as time passes. 

I can’t say enough good things about my coach, Anika. She’s consistently encouraging in a way that feels genuine and motivating. Whenever I share what I’m struggling with, she truly listens and responds with practical, actionable advice that helps me keep moving forward. Her support has made a huge difference in my progress and consistency.

title: Good, only using free version
body:
App is great just for logging weight and reps digitally and customize workouts. Great and broad selection of exercises.
My one and only gripe is the way that from an user interface point, the exercise complete and the timer buttons get mixed up --this is to say I often intuitively hit
Complete when I want to get the timer going in between sets. Seeing as you only press the complete button once and the timer button 2-4 times, it would make more sense to make the timer button more visible (I. E. Red lol) and the complete button a little less so. Great job otherwise.

title: Phenomenal Support
body: For years, I’ve looked for one place where I could find physical training support, nutritional guidance, and accountability. Caliber has provided that in a way that is completely tailored to my needs. My trainer, Regina, is amazing. She adapts my nutrition and training so that it is incorporated into my life seamlessly. She’s able to adapt my training when I travel, she encourages me to enjoy celebrations while being mindful of my goals, and motivates me to continue making progress every day. She has helped me become a stronger and healthier person both mentally and physically. I’m very thankful I found Caliber!

title: Awesome app,
body: Lots of exercise are missing instructions video and please add 4 day split upper and lower body.

title: Not a physiologically grounded training program
body: I had an introduction call to see whether the training program was the right fit for me. During this call I was told repeatedly that the program would be adjusted based on my specific needs and goals. I then signed up and paid for the first month and was connected with a trainer. We had a kickoff call and I was very explicit about my goals. On the call she mentioned a few things that were irrelevant to my specific situation but I kind of rushed it off like standard protocol. However the following day she delivered a training program that was clearly not aligned with what I was looking to accomplish. There also was information that was not appropriate, as it aligned more with cultural norms than scientific evidence. It is my expectation as an athlete to treat my body with the utmost diligence and what was being suggested would have been remarkably harmful. I push back but it was clear that their philosophy was rooted in something other than physiological adaption. Their program may be OK for somebody who is needing to lose a significant amount of weight or is currently inactive, but if you are reasonably healthy and understand how your body uniquely works then I would seriously suggest not risking this program. I also had to email three times in order for them to process the refund.

title: It's good for tracking
body:
It keeps good record of progress. And has a good library of moves (though if you want in depth core moves with the kettle ball it's very lacking. 
My biggest gripe is the assessment, aka strength score. My weight is going up, because presumably I'm putting on muscle, but even though I'm increasing my weights or reps every workout, my strength score goes down and it says it's because my weight went up. Like it went up less than a pound. So that kinda craps on your motivation, which I think would be the last thing an app like this would strive for.

title: Highly recommend
body: I’ve been using this app for 3 weeks now and so far hasn’t failed me yet. It’s got everything I need in the free version alone. Track weights, reps and it’s got a rest timer. Wrote a decent workout plan for me in less than 5 minutes and I’ve been using it the whole time and already seeing progress. It just asks you a few basic questions about your body and your goals and then poof, your plan comes to life just like that. And as you progress you can even edit your workouts however you want. Add more, switch out the ones you don’t like for different ones. Literally anything. And that’s all in the free version. You can get premium if you want lessons or an online coach if you want but I already had some experience so I didn’t need it. But it’s there. Great app. I love it. 5 stars.

title: Good people in this company
body: Do not be afraid to try this app and company.  I had a very positive experience with them.

title: Functional and easy
body: Caliber is very functional and easy to use. Of all the fitness apps I have tried it is probably the best bang for you buck in terms of usability, features, and cost. The recent Strava integration is a big help.

title: Excellent Program & App
body:
I’ve had a terrific experience using Caliber over the past few months. The app itself is one of the things I appreciate most—it’s simple, elegant, and highly functional without unnecessary bells and whistles that can turn fitness into a time sink. Everything feels purposeful and easy to use.

My trainer, Tara, has been outstanding. She quickly understood my goals and created customized programs that were exactly what I needed. I have a modest home gym (dumbbells, bands, mat, step, BOSU, balance ball), and she designed workouts that made great use of my equipment along with bodyweight exercises. The programs are well-paced, achievable, and don’t require a huge time commitment, which makes it realistic to stay consistent. I typically complete four workouts per week and supplement with hiking, biking, and walking.

One of the biggest benefits was the accountability—knowing a professional was following my progress, making thoughtful tweaks, and offering encouragement when needed. Tara struck the perfect balance: supportive and responsive without over-communicating. I’ve seen noticeable results in strength, balance, and overall fitness, which was exactly my goal as I focus on staying healthy and strong as I age.

I think Caliber’s premium coaching is an excellent option for people who prefer working out at home, don’t have easy access to a gym, or want expert guidance combined with time efficiency. If you’re looking for a customized program, professional accountability, and clean, well-designed technology, Caliber is one of the best platforms out there.

title: 6 month Caliber subscriber
body:
I’ve been a paid subscriber for about 6 months.   I’ve gotten a lot of value from the weekly check-ins and direction with nutrition.  

Tanner has been the best at keeping me on track and accountable.  If you’re struggling with your routine I would highly recommend investing in yourself with Caliber.  I don’t think most people would need the level of check-ins that I’m doing, but being a 50+ year old, I needed a true reset and different mindset to work from.  Tanner has allowed me to question current habits, push further ahead each week, and he’s instilling in me that this is a way to change how you live for the long haul. 

I’ve been very impressed and look forward to doing this on my own someday because it’s so routine.   For now, though… I’m a committed customer!

title: Amazing App, even free version
body: This is an absolutely amazing app. I have been using it for years now and have gone from gym beginner to something of an intermediate. There are so many features, and I’ve used the free version for my entire usage of the app. It’s so cool to see how you progress, which muscles you hit in each exercise, and last week’s weight on this week’s exercises for comparisons. 100% recommend!

title: Cardio isn’t free
body: Concept seemed great, but you can’t log any cardio workouts on the free version so it’s useless to me. The home page is way too busy and it’s hard to figure out how to add a workout in the first place. I like the idea of the various communities but I wish you could make your own for anyone to join. The busy interface mixed with the lack of cardio options on the free version makes it not worth it in my opinion.

title: Deceptive marketing
body: Another scammy app. Advertises that it’s free, but you only get a 7-day free trial. Maybe be more truthful in your marketing. Scam artist

title: Great App but failed to deliver the forgot password emails
body: It was great at first until I was logged out and have not been able to get back in since the forgot password email has failed to send, which made me lose all of my workout plans putting a delay in my workouts due to me having to re plan everything.

title: Meh
body: Bought it then found better elsewhere.   Could be amazing but some glaring flaws, notably almost all of them are mentioned ad nauseam in the customer suggestion area.  Some of my most frustrating points- constantly accidentally ending my workout without trying to, having to constantly edit and add weights instead of it having a baseline button that fills in last workouts numbers that I can make adjustments to, and for the love of god, your strength balance visual is worthless, inaccurate, and pisses me off.  It says I’ve only worked one muscle group, been using this for 3 months and it used to work but after an update it erased my progress and now just says I only do pecs and back.

title: Highly Recommend
body: I am very happy with Caliber. I tried several gym memberships which inevitably did not work out due to time constraints for certain classes. With Caliber, I can use my own neighborhood gym but I get personal training right when I can do it. Great decision!

title: SCAM APP
body: Absolutely DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS ABSOLUTE GARBAGE APP!! Trust me you’ll thank me later

title: Paywall
body:
All features are behind a paywall.

Edit Response to developer: That is blatantly untrue. Anytime you try do anything in the app you are prompted with upgrade to plus.

title: 1 year with coach Tim!
body: I worked with coach Tim for the past year! He was great, asked me my goals, tailored a plan for my goals, answered my questions and taught me everything i needed to know to be on my own. Including nutrition. He gave me new workouts every 6 weeks, adjusted my macros and answered every question i had. I was able to chat with him as needed and he gave me a video review each week. I saw real progress and did reach my goals! I will continue using caliber and come back to caliber and coach tim in the future if i want more coaching. Definitely worth the money! And it was very affordable. Highly recommend coach Tim!

title: Lies
body: This is not free like your add says.

title: Captain
body:
As an airline pilot for a major US airline, I travel a lot!
It’s a sedentary job but demands both mental and physical fitness. 
I was looking for a fitness app I could use on the road in hotel gyms with limited equipment and home at the local gym. The Caliber app has so many exercises available so I can modify the plan when needed. 
Everything is built in!
A video with correct form, timers, sets, reps, weight, history etc.
My trainer/coach, Westley is awesome! He builds the workout plans, gives me tips and feedback on my form all with the right amount of accountability and encouragement. He looks at my diet too. I always appreciate his messages both written and video in the app and I always feel like he’s invested in my plan.
I’ve put on a bunch of muscle since starting with Caliber. My Caliber “Strength Score” keeps going up and I just hit intermediate level which feels good. 
I’ve come along way since my first meeting with Wesley. Thanks to him and Caliber I’m in the best shape of my adult life.

title: Perfect
body: Exactly what I need. And free. Can’t beat it.

title: Too hard to look at
body: Requires a lot of personal information to even see what it’s like. Deleted.

title: Great for all skill levels
body: I have been using Caliber for about a year now. It has been easy to use and tremendously helpful to track all my exercises. I have been consistently increasing my reps and weight like never before.

title: The perfect app
body: This is genuinely the most useful and easy to use workout app I’ve used. Even the free plan is great

title: Great program for tailored strength training
body: I am about to finish the three month Caliber program with Brian. I have known for a while that I needed to mix in more strength training to my workout regime to avoid injury and support overall longevity, just didn’t know how and wanted it to be tailored to my needs. It has been great working with Brian and using the app to evolve my exercises over time and stay accountable. Love the easy messaging on any questions and the eye on nutrition. Would definitely recommend.

title: Put me on a good start
body: This app has help me build a healthy lifestyle by putting in a good workout routine and a calorie deficit.

title: Great app! Completely changed how I approach my fitness plan.

title: Why does this keep happening
body: I love your app mostly. I am very new to your app and strength training, I come from a yoga/ Pilates background. The frustration that I have with the app is that I will be working out and accidentally go back to find something I saw before, or accidentally close the window, and I can’t get back to my exercise program. It’s closed out. I have to create a flexible workout with those exercises to complete my program? There has to be a better way.

title: Great app!
body: I like that you get a lot of features before having to pay for premium.

title: Love the app and Coach Tara!
body: Coach Tara is helping me meet my fitness goals!

title: Best Results so Far!
body: I’ve really been enjoying this app. Both the function of the app and the coaching feature. The app function is pretty straight forward, with good descriptions and videos to help make sure you’re doing the exercises correctly. The tracking function is intuitive and helpful. Additionally the library of lessons is super informative and useful.  However my most favorite part of this app is the coaching feature with an actual person. I’ve worked with multiple trainers over the years and I’ve had the most success with my strength and longevity goals working with my coach at Caliber.  The coach I have been working with has had the best insight on my personal capabilities and limitations. He is super experienced and super thoughtful when giving advice and developing my program. I highly recommend this app, and especially for the coaching feature.

title: Exceptional Programming and Value
body: I’ve tried numerous apps/programs over the years, many of which were far more expensive than Caliber, and Caliber is by far the best.  The app is great.  The coaches are great.  Perhaps most importantly, the culture is great.  Caliber is clearly committed to working with its customers to help them achieve their best results—not simply in generating revenue or viral instagram posts.  With Caliber you get concierge level service from coaches who really know what they’re doing for less than the price of an elite gym membership BEFORE you add personal training to the tab.  You will not find a better”bang for your buck” anywhere.  HIGHLY recommend.

title: Misleading
body: It stated that it was a free app. But what it meant was you can download the app for free and if you want to use it, buy it. This had a lot of potential but I can’t purchase a $72 subscription right now. If this was truly free it would have been great.

title: Excellent Personal Training Experience
body:
Do not sleep on this app or the personal training! TLDR: I’m a  woman who is reasonably experienced with strength training and this app and my trainer moved me to a whole new level without injury.

 I’m a 62 y.o. woman who has participated in conventional exercise methods since the 1980’s (looking at you Jane Fonda and your leg warmers).  I’ve found it overwhelming to find an app that can get me to my goals without injury or starving myself.  I was skeptical of Caliber.  Seemed too simple.  But I was not making much progress with the expensive training/nutrition plans “geared to the needs of women” or the less expensive plan created by a celebrity body-builder type (who also moonlighted as a governor at one time). Caliber and Coach Brittany helped me lose the inches off my waist that I’ve been stuck with for years. I’ve also visibly rebuilt muscle in 12 weeks. No small feat at my age.  The idea of progressive overload is straightforward and there a ton of exercises to choose from. You can go it alone easily or get whatever guidance you need from a professional coach.  Either way, the app does most of  the thinking for you - so, you can just show up and exercise.  Highly recommend.

title: Exceptional Experience
body:
This app is perfect for anyone seeking structure, guidance and effectiveness for strength training. 

I am 61 and have always had a workout routine but this definitely took me up a notch! 

Bethany Toma has been my personal trainer through the app and she has been phenomenal in customizing, consistent communication, professionalism, accountability and encouragement along the way.

My strength has increased exponentially and I am very happy with the overall progress I’ve made!

title: Great no frills app
body: Has everything I need. Haven’t tried the personal training.

title: 3 Months Turnaround!
body: i’m closing in on my first three month program, and could not be any happier with my results. For the first time, I feel emboldened to continue a fitness program and see how far I can go. I imagine this app shares a lot of interface similarities with other fitness apps., But the difference maker for me was the human aspect through the personal coaching. After a brief phone call with a representative, I was assigned Mario as a personal coach and he has been integral to the success this program. Mario has shown great communication skills and his approach is realistic practical and understanding. All of those attributes have helped contribute to all the gains I’ve seen. Obviously, this is all balanced by the consistency to a commitment on my behalf to feel better in my body, so that will always be the ultimate determining factor: you get what you put in. This app and it’s training staff are fully capable to help you get there, you just have to answer the call.

title: Decent

title: Good but lots room for improvement
body: The app does what it’s supposed to. The program library is great. You’ll definitely find a program that will meet your goals whatever they are. And the exercise library is reasonably decent. The strength score is an excellent heuristic for general strength progression, however there’s no explanation for where that score is coming from and no means to adjust the formula to fit your specific goals. Certainly there are weighting factors assigned to different muscles, motion patterns, etc. Those weighting factors should be customizable to fit your specific goals, but the app basically decides for you what is being weighted and to what degree. Data logging is fine, but data visualization is lacking. Nothing more than simple line charts. That’s it. You can’t even export your logged data so that it can be manipulated elsewhere.

title: Life-changing
body: This is the first app that I’m actually writing a review for it because it means that much to me. I literally recommend it to all my friends who have anxiety in the gym. Especially if they are new to the gym or new to working out by themselves. Which is what had occurred for me. My best friend moved away, and she was who I basically leaned onto to guide our workouts. After inputting all of my workout routines, this app became such a clutch for me to ensure that I always stay on track and I’m able to know what weight I used the week prior. I also really love the strength balance feature and just knowing what parts of my body I may be over focusing on. 10 out of 10 ⭐️

title: Excellent
body:
I remember googling different apps to track and help with workouts.  At first I just had it with adjustable dumbbells I’d use in my living room and would follow their workouts.

Eventually got myself back into the gym and with the library of exercises they have, it makes working out much easier.  Example being the different specific muscles you target, this way you know which ones to target based on your workout.  The library is also useful if you are at the gym on a time crunch and if the machine or rack or bench etc are being used, you can look up another exercise in seconds for something that is available.

Would recommend this for anyone who goes to the gym consistently for weight training or even those just starting, especially since it’s free.

title: Caliber Helped Me Regain My Strength
body:
After dealing with shingles for two months last year, I was out of shape, drained, and hesitant to jump back into strength training. At 46, I had lost a good amount of weight but was feeling physically weak — and more importantly, unsure how to start again without risking injury. That’s when I found Caliber, and everything changed.

From the very beginning, Johnny, my coach, stood out as someone truly invested in my health. During our initial consultation, he listened intently — not just to my goals, but to my history, including old injuries that make certain exercises a challenge. He took everything I said seriously. I never once felt dismissed or rushed, which had been a constant frustration with other apps and trainers.

Johnny customized a program that was thoughtful, safe, and incredibly motivating. Every exercise felt purposeful. He gave detailed feedback, adjusted routines when something didn’t feel right, and pushed me just the right amount to rediscover my old strength — and then surpass it.

Over just three months, I experienced a level of progress I hadn’t thought possible. I’m lifting more than I ever imagined at this stage in life. Every week I felt stronger, more capable, and more confident in my body. It’s hard to describe how powerful that is when you’ve been feeling broken for a long time.

What sets Caliber apart is how seriously they take their coaching. It’s not a generic plan or a bot-generated routine. It’s real human coaching with professional-level care. Other training apps I’ve tried felt impersonal or gimmicky — Caliber is the real deal.

If you’re like me — older than your 20s, working through some injuries, and trying to regain control over your strength and health — Caliber (and especially Johnny) might be exactly what you need. This was hands down one of the best decisions I’ve made for my fitness in years.

Thank you, Johnny, and thank you, Caliber!

title: 10 month review from a 70 year old male
body:
I am 70 years old, healthy and active. The book “Outlive” makes a strong case for the value of weight training for folks my age. The goal is to live out as many more years as I can with vigor, with the ability to continue to thrive: physically and mentally. 

So after training mostly body-weight exercises for nearly a year I installed Caliber on my phone. I was at first impressed by the concept of “relative strength” and how the app would give you weekly ratings of it. So after 10 months of training here is my review:

I signed up with a coach, Cameron who set up a weight routine of four times a week. 

The best thing about Caliber is 1) the routine that Cameron set me up with is really good. 2) the ability to log my sets and reps and see a complete history of each exercise and to keep notes about how i feel with each exercise, 3) having someone to answer to, to ask questions, to review my execution of the exercises video, to adapt my routine to injuries, etc.  A face to face trainer is expensive. This is a great less expensive alternative. 

The relative strength thing has proven to be more confusing and discouraging than helpful. My body looks and feels stronger than it has in a very long time but the relative strength goes up when it seems it should go down and down when it seems it should go up. 

A trainer once wrote that one should judge his progressed based on the mirror rather than the scale. It seems he may have been on to something.

title: It’s just ok
body: It’s really frustrating. I want to like it but the interface is just difficult. Every workout I have to go and manually enter the exercise and if I don’t know the specific wording that the app uses, the exercise doesn’t come up. I’m sitting on a machine right now trying to find rear delt fly. Delt fly. Deltoid fly, rear deltoid fly. None of it comes up. I know it’s in here, I’ve found it before but now I have to go back though old workouts to try and find it, and that’s a huge pain. The search function for exercises is horrible. I spend more time on the app than I do exercising. I don’t get why I can’t just build a workout I want, then pull that one up and log it, add to it, modify it as I go. It’s really confusing. The interface could be better.

title: Best Workout App Out There!
body:
I have tried so many workout apps and this is truly the best one that fits my needs. They have so many already loaded workouts that I haven’t needed to create any so I can’t give a review on that, but I did have their AI build me a workout and honestly it was pretty spot on. You can easily change things and fit it to your needs and the equipment or lack there of. It also auto tracks your workouts you log on Apple so I don’t have to go into the app and manually add it. 

Just like with anything they could improve some things like mass adding workouts to multiple days or setting it up to auto populate each week till you cancel it. 

But that’s honestly so minor in the grand scheme of things. 

Best workout app and I plan on pushing this out to all my friends.
